summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle on npm install
details: @or-sdk/permissions-lambda 2.5.1 declares preinstall="node setup.mjs" in package.json. On npm install, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory and then execFileSync's the dropped Bun binary against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (leading `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotator function, shuffled ~1000-element mixed-type constant array, hex-mangled identifiers like _0x488df8). The package advertises itself as an AWS Lambda permissions SDK client, a purpose that does not require a second language runtime. Fetching an alternate runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle bypasses Node-based static analysis and means the installer cannot audit what actually runs on their machine when they run npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
